sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Sign Builder Illustrated represents the community of signage and graphics professionals shaping the industry, offering a platform for experts to share how-to advice on fabrication techniques and business practices.

Industry: Publishing · Size: 1-49 · Products: Magazine, Digital Edition, Videos, Webinars, Podcasts, Newsletters

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Sign Builder Illustrated scores 30 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (12/30) and event engagement (15/15). Nothing was found for application fit and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (27% similar on signage, digital, vinyl, sign); Drytac (22% similar on graphics, display, sign, media); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (15% similar on graphics, vinyl, digital, signage). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
• Pain-point alignment: Each additional durability theme found adds 5 points.
• Flags on the record: size third party estimate
